s: puM, (svasmin lInaH .) dAnavaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “tAmAyAntIntu roDAya svalIno nAma dAnavaH । pArvvataM rUpamAsTAgra varzARAntu SatErdvijAH ॥ tato BagIraTo rAjArADayAmAsa kOSikam ॥ sa tuzwaH pradadO nAgaM vAhanaM taM magIraTaH । tamAruhyAgamattatra yatra rudDA BagIraTI ॥ tena nAgena taM dEtyaM saMvidAryya na saNgatam । SataDA tAM samADAya mUrdDvanyErAvaRo gajaH ॥ mahItalaM samApede sa yAvannAgasAhvayam । tasmAdvyAGawanAdviprA aBUnnAgapuraM varam ॥” iti vahnipurARe gaNgAvataraRanAmADyAyaH ॥
m: स्व—लीन m. N. of a Dānava, L.
स्वलीन m. N. of a Dānava, VahniP.
स्व्-अलंकृत् and स्व्-अलंकृत, mfn. beautifully adorned, MBh.
स्वलदा f. N. of a daughter of Raudrāśva.
स्व—लक्षण n. peculiar characteristic or property, MBh.
स्व—लक्षण mfn. having its own specific characteristics, Sarvad.
स्व-लक्षण , स्व-लिखित &c. See p. 1276, col. 3.
स्व—लक्षण—प्रकाश m. N. of wk.
स्व्-अलक्षित mfn. altogether unseen, not thoroughly observed, BhP.
स्व—लिखित n. any document or receipt written with one's own hand, Viṣṇ.
स्व—लिङ्ग mfn. preserving (its) own grammatical gender, L.
स्वल्पाङ्गुलि f. the little finger, L.
स्वल्पान्तर mfn. little different, Bc.
स्वल्पापहार mfn. eating very little, most abstemious, MW.
स्वल्पातिविस्तर mf(आ)n. very concise and very diffuse, Cat.
स्वल्पायु or स्वल्पा˚युस्, mfn. short-lived, Hāsy.
स्वल्पी-√ भू P. -भवति (p.p. -भूत), to become small, melt away (as merit), Megh.
स्वल्पीयस् mfn. very little (property), Mn. xi, 8.
a: स्वल्पीयस् — a. Much less, smaller, more minute (compar. of स्वल्प q. v.).

s: tri, (suzWu alpaH .) atyalpaH । yaTA, -- “nehAtikramanASo'sti pratyavAyo na vidyate । svalpamapyasya Darmmasya trAyate mahato BayAt ॥” iti BagavadgItAyAm । 2 । 40 ॥
v: tri॰ suzWu alpam prA॰ sa॰ । atyalpe kzudre ।
m: स्व्-अल्प mf(आ)n. very small or little, minute, very few, short (एन, ‘in a short time’), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: स्वल्प — a. [सुष्ठु अल्पं प्रा. स] (compar. स्वल्पीयस्; superl. स्वल्पिष्ठ) 1 Very small or little, minute. --2 Trifling, insignificant. --3 Brief, short; स्वल्पं तथायुः Pt. 1. --4 Very few. --Comp. --आहार a. eating very little, most abstemious. --कंकः a species of heron. --केशरिन् m. the Kovidāra tree. --बल a. very feeble or weak. --विषयः {1} an insignificant matter. {2} a small part. --व्ययः very little expenditure, stinginess. --व्रीड a. having little shame, shameless, impudent. --शरीर a. diminutive, dwarfish.

s: strI, (svalpaM PalaM yasyAH .) hapuzABedaH । tatparyyAyaH । kacCUGrI 2 DyANkanASinI 3 plIhaSatraH 4 vizaGI 5 kaPaGnI 6 aparAjitA 7 । asyA guRAH hapuzAguRatulyAH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: strI svalpaM PalaM yasyAH । hapusABede rAjani॰ ।
m: स्व्-अल्प—फला f. ‘having small-sized fruit’, Andersonia Rohitaka, L.
स्व्-अल्प—शरीर mfn. having a very diminutive body, small in stature, L.
स्व्-अल्प—शिला f. a very small stone
स्व्-अल्प—शि˚लाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to become a very small stone, Bhartṛ.
स्व्-अल्प—बल mfn. extremely weak or feeble, Hit.
स्व्-अल्प—देहा f. a dwarfish girl unfit for marriage, L.
स्व्-अल्प—दृश् mfn. very shortsighted (metaphorically), Rājat.
स्व्-अल्प—द्रावक n. a partic. mineral preparation, L.
स्व्-अल्प—दुःख n. very little pain, Ml.
स्व्-अल्प—जातक n. N. of wk. by Varāha-mihira (also called सूक्ष्म-ज्˚).
स्वल्पक mf(इका)n. very small or minute or short, AV.; &c.
a: स्वल्पक — a. Very little, very small or few.

m: स्व्-अल्प—कङ्क m. a species of heron (= भूकाक), MW.

s: [n] puM, (svalpaH keSo'syAstIti । iniH .) BUtakeSaH । yaTA, -- “golomI svalpakeSI ca BUtakeSaSca keSaGfk ॥” iti SabdacandrikA ॥ avyalpakeSaviSizwe, tri ॥

[n] puM, (svalpaH keSaro'syAstIti । iniH .) kovidAraH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (paryyAyo'sya yaTA, -- “kovidAraScamarikaH kuddAlo yugapatrakaH । kuRqalI tAmrapuzpaSca antakaH svalpakeSarI ॥” iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe praTame BAge ॥)

v: pu॰ svalpaH keSaro nityamastyasya ini । kovi dAravfkze rAjani॰ ।
tri॰ svalpaH keSo nityamastyasya! 1 atyalpakeSayute striyAM NIp । 2 piSAcaBede pu॰ Sabdaca॰ ।
m: स्व्-अल्प—केशिन् m. ‘having small fibres’, the root of sweet flag, L.
स्व्-अल्प—केसरिन् m. ‘having small filaments’, Bauhinia Variegata, L.

s: puM, (svalpAni patrARi yasya । kap .) gOraSAkaH । sa tu maDUkaBedaH । yaTA, -- “gOraSARo maDuro'stro girijaH svalpapatrakaH ॥” iti ratnamAlA ॥

v: pu॰ svalpaM pattramasya kap । gOraSAke maDUkaBede ratnamA॰ ।
m: स्व्-अल्प—पत्त्रक m. ‘small-leaved’, a kind of Madhūka or Bassia Latifolia, L.
स्व्-अल्प—स्मृति mfn. having a short memory, Mṛcch.
स्व्-अल्प—तन्त्र mfn. consisting of short sections, concisely written (-त्व n.), Kathās.
स्व्-अल्प—तन्त्र—त्व n.
स्व्-अल्प—तर mfn. very insignificant or unimportant, Mn.; Pañcat.
स्व्-अल्प—तस् ind. quite gradually, MBh. xii, 5221 (v.l.)
स्व्-अल्प—वयस् mfn. very young, Kathās.
स्व्-अल्प—वित्त-वत् mfn. possessing very little property, Hcat.
स्व्-अल्प—विषय m. a very small matter or object, W. a small part, ib.
स्व्-अल्प—व्रीड mfn. having little shame, shameless, impudent, W.
स्व्-अल्प—व्यय m. very little expenditure, MW.
स्व्-अल्प—व्यय mfn. spending very little, very niggardly, ib.
स्व्-अल्प—यात्रा f. the shorter Yātrā (by Varāha-mihira), VarBṛS., Sch.
स्वल्पेच्छ mfn. having few wishes, unpretentious, unassuming (-ता f.), Car.
स्वल्पेच्छ—ता f.

a: स्वल्पिष्ठ — a. Smallest, least, most minute (superl. of स्वल्प q. v.).
